result.brief: 提出 CriticJEPA：从无奖励轨迹学习目标条件流提议，并用冻结的分层世界模型 rollout 作为评判器逐层选择候选，在视觉导航与操作任务上以更低规划算力提升成功率。
result.reason: Learns goal-conditioned flow proposals and uses frozen JEPA world-model rollouts as critics for planning; contributes to world-model-based planning and representation-driven selection.
